decisions.reason: Maintenance oil remains tightly linked to our core knowledge in wood-floor surface treatment and aftercare, and the fact that it survived the earlier portfolio review suggests we can keep improving it through internal R&D and installer feedback.

High-density underlay foam still fits our flooring system offer and benefits from our adjacent technical knowledge, but as a more standardised accessory it carries a somewhat higher risk of withdrawal if margin or demand disappoints.
The oak parquet line is very close to our strongest absorptive base in wood processing, design, production, and flooring sales, so it is the least likely of the remaining launches to be discontinued.
